BEFORE YOU RUN

Good questions.

Clear expectations make better datasets.

Does this page crawl websites?+

No. This page lets you explore fictional sample data and generate Actor input locally. Open the Actor on Apify, paste the input JSON, and start a run to crawl real websites.

Will it find every email and technology?+

No. Findings depend on the public pages fetched and recognizable markup. Email addresses are not guessed or verified for deliverability. Technology signals can be incomplete or ambiguous; review their evidence. Missing data is not proof that a business has no contact details or does not use a technology.

What about protected or JavaScript-only websites?+

JavaScript-rendered content may be unavailable to the HTML-based crawl. Robots.txt is respected by default. Login walls, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, and anti-bot protections are not bypassed. A blocked or partial result should be reviewed, not treated as complete.

Can I use the data for outreach?+

Public availability is not permission to send marketing. Review the source website's terms, applicable privacy and marketing rules, and the purpose of your processing. SiteSignal does not send messages or automate spam.

What is stored on this website?+

The URL form, filtering, and downloads run in your browser. Form input is not uploaded by this page. Your language preference may be stored locally. Actor runs and datasets are handled by Apify under your account and its retention settings.
